metrics.longBusinessSummary: 2B Intelligent Soft S.A., a technology company, provides software development, IT, and cloud infrastructure services to accelerate digital transformation across various industries in Romania. The company delivers solutions that empower businesses in energy, utilities, telecom, and field service. Its products include BENTO Field Service Management and BENTO Mobile Device Management that are digital platforms to optimize field operations, secure mobile devices, and streamline enterprise-level workflows. The company's products also comprise BENTO Granar, a warehouse management application for owners of silos, warehouses, or grain depots; and BENTO smart metering and energy management allows remote monitoring of energy consumption and production, and other signals received from various sensors. It also provides IT services that are focuses on the design, implementation, and management of complex IT architectures. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Bucharest, Romania.

Dn Agrar Group S.A., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production of cow milk. The company is involved in animal husbandry, raising dairy cattle, and agricultural grain production. It offers agricultural, logistics, transport, and tourism, as well as business and management consulting services. In addition, the company engages in milk production, crop farming, organic composting, and green energy business. Further, it is involved in growing and cultivation of cereals, legume, and oilseed crops; wholesale of agricultural machinery, equipment, and supplies; renting and subletting of own or rented real estate; ancillary activities for plant production; and other accommodation services. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Alba Iulia, Romania.

Premier Energy PLC operates as an integrated energy and power infrastructure company in Romania, Moldova, Hungary, and Serbia. The company operates through Production of Electricity; Distribution of Electricity and Natural Gas; Supply of Electricity and Natural Gas; and Developments of Production of Electricity segments. The company owns approximately 1,800 MW of renewable electricity generation and 469 MWh storage capacity under ownership, management, or in development. It is also involved in the supply of electricity and natural gas to household and small business customers. The company was formerly known as Premier Energy Cyprus Limited and changed its name to Premier Energy PLC in March 2021. Premier Energy PLC was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Nicosia, Cyprus. Premier Energy PLC is a subsidiary of Emma Alpha Holding Limited.

Safetech Innovations S.A. provides cybersecurity products and services in Romania. The company offers Information Security Automation Manager, an application for the automation of information security management; ICS Detect which offers bundle of services for securing industrial control systems with honeypot technology; and MMI, an integrated software platform for malware analysis of mobile devices. It also provides network, email, cloud, and API security; security incidents detection and response; cybersecurity event and incident management; therat and breach intelligence; privilege and identity assurance; asset management and security; attack surface and vulnerability management; OT and ICs cybersecurity; and cybersecurity awareness solutions. In addition, the company offers consulting and training; security testing and auditing; professional; and outsourcing services. It serves various industries, including financial-banking, energy, oil and gas, utilities, health, insurance, industrial production, high tech, retail, distribution, public sector, consulting, gaming. Safetech Innovations S.A. was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Bucharest, Romania.

OMV Petrom S.A., an energy company, engages in the exploration and production of oil and gas in Romania and rest of Europe. It operates through three segments: Exploration and Production; Refining and Marketing; and Gas and Power. The Exploration and Production segment engages in the exploration, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas. The Refining and Marketing segment produces and delivers gasoline, diesel, and other petroleum products through Petrobrazi refinery; and provides services and non-oil business products. The Gas and Power segment engages in the production of electricity, as well as sale of gas and power; and operates gas fired power plant. It also offers airport, medical, financial, IT, and other services; produces bioethanol products; and operates charging network for electric vehicles, as well as filling stations and distributes products to retail and wholesale customers. The company was founded in 1857 and is headquartered in Bucharest, Romania. OMV Petrom S.A. operates as a subsidiary of OMV Aktiengesellschaft.

Banca Transilvania S.A. provides various banking products and services in Romania, Italy, and the Republic of Moldova. The company operates through Large Corporate Clients, Medium Corporate Customers, SME clients, Micro Business clients, Retail customers, Treasury, Leasing and consumer finance granted by non-banking financial institutions, and Other segments. It offers transactional banking products, current account subscriptions, bancassurance products, debit and credit cards, deposits and savings accounts, consumer loans and mortgages, and ATM services to children, students, and employees. The company also provides transaction banking, treasury, trade finance, and retail products, as well as asset management, merger and acquisition consultancy, and capital market advisory services to legal and public entities, and financial institutions. In addition, it offers lending, current and treasury operations; bonus packages, structured finance, and co-financing of EU-funded projects; and bancassurance, and financial and operating leasing services, as well as lease facilities, microfinance, brokerage, factoring, and real estate services. Further, the company provides loans for working capital or investments, letters of guarantee, EU project co-financing, invoice discounting, and factoring; general and FX operations, incoming and outgoing payments, cheques, promissory notes, and salary payment agreements; and internet and mobile banking, e-commerce, POSs and, the integration service of financial data to limited liability companies, freelancers, and sole proprietorships. Additionally, it offers services to companies that have undergone the incipient growth stages and whose business activity requires further attention. Banca Transilvania S.A. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Cluj-Napoca, Romania.
